name: Mousou ga Tomaranai Hentai Jukujo no Haruna-san
original_name: 妄想が止まらない変態熟女の春奈さん
source:
Looking at the male students from her apartment, Haruna can't stop fantasizing about being raped by these lustful boys.

Days of enjoying nighttime masturbation, fantasizing about various scenarios. Although she felt empty on such days, she thought that it was her fault for being a pervert... She had resigned herself to the fact that it couldn't be helped. One day, a male student named Manabu moves into the room next to Haruna's to attend a school in her neighborhood. 

"Himejima Academy - Boys' Branch -''

He is said to be attending a preparatory school where only selected students are allowed to enroll. A student named Manabu uses a school-provided hypnosis app on Haruna, claiming it's for a school assignment. A dazzling light dyed her vision white and the sound of a shutter echoed, but there was no way Haruna would be hypnotized like in some manga! However, Haruna saw this as an opportunity to fulfill her own desires. Although Haruna feels uncomfortable with Manabu's actions, she decides that she will pretend to be hypnotized by Manabu and make her fantasies come true...

她夜夜自慰，幻想着不同的情景，并以此为乐。这样的日子有时也让她觉得空虚，但她只怪自己是个变态…最后也只能认了。一天，为了就近上学，一个叫阿学的男生搬进了隔壁。

“姬岛学园男子分校”。

据说，那是所只收少数入选学生的升学名校。阿学声称要做学校布置的作业，拿校方发给他的催眠应用对春奈做起了实验。刺眼的光让她眼前一白，随即传来快门声。可春奈当然没像漫画里那样真的被催眠！她反倒把这看成满足自己欲望的机会。尽管阿学的举动也让她觉得不自在，春奈还是决定假装受到催眠，好让幻想成真…
